parameters.query: SELECT d.*, to_char(d."Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date" FROM health.day_sum d ORDER BY d."Date"
SELECT t."Нутриент", t."Колонка_в_Meals", t."Единица", t."Норма_RDA_AI", t."Верхний_предел_UL", t."Категория", t."Источник", t."Примечание" FROM health.nutrient_targets t ORDER BY t."Нутриент"
SELECT m.*, to_char(m."Date" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Vladivostok', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS "Date" FROM health.meals m ORDER BY m."Date"

SELECT r."Date", r."Period_Type", r."Recommendation_Text", r."Based_On", r."Status", r."Priority", r."Telegram_Text", r."Alert_Text", r."Has_Alert" FROM health.recommendations_log r ORDER BY r."Date" DESC

parameters.query: SELECT d.*, to_char(d."Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date" FROM health.day_sum d ORDER BY d."Date"
SELECT t."Нутриент", t."Колонка_в_Meals", t."Единица", t."Норма_RDA_AI", t."Верхний_предел_UL", t."Категория", t."Источник", t."Примечание" FROM health.nutrient_targets t ORDER BY t."Нутриент"
SELECT m.*, to_char(m."Date" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Vladivostok', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS "Date" FROM health.meals m ORDER BY m."Date"

SELECT r."Date", r."Period_Type", r."Recommendation_Text", r."Based_On", r."Status", r."Priority", r."Telegram_Text", r."Alert_Text", r."Has_Alert" FROM health.recommendations_log r ORDER BY r."Date" DESC
